# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers step-by-step guidance and does not want code unless explicitly requested.
- User wants beginner-level, first-time guidance for the rest of the project with step-by-step pacing.
- User prefers keeping block-style namespaces in this project's files.
- User wants code shown only in small, bit-by-bit increments when working in ImportsController.cs; not full-file dumps.

## API Testing Preferences
- User prefers using Postman instead of Swagger for API testing.
